kind: manual guide-to-runtime review scenarios, not model evaluations
basis: skill-creator guidance for realistic prompts and discriminating expected outcomes; no providers or baseline model runs authorized in this review

scenarios.request: Create a repo-scoped read-only reviewer named check-reader; do not start it.
scenarios.expected: List definitions/problems; create complete writable-scope definition through agentdef; read back; no provider launch.
scenarios.nearMiss: Start the existing reviewer on TM-123.

scenarios.request: Which definitions can review changes, and what is check-reader instructed to do?
scenarios.expected: agents JSON list plus detail; preserve persona/checksum distinction and collisions; no mutation.
scenarios.nearMiss: Who is currently running in tmux?

scenarios.request: Change check-reader description but preserve its persona and tool restrictions.
scenarios.expected: Read full definition/checksum; check live workers; submit full replacement with checksum; read back; stale conflict never unchecked retry.
scenarios.nearMiss: Create another reviewer under a new name.

scenarios.request: Remove the unused check-reader definition I just created.
scenarios.expected: Read definition/scope/checksum and live state; authorized agentdrop with checksum; readback absence; no direct unlink.

scenarios.request: Propose a team for TM-123; I have not approved any hires.
scenarios.expected: Inspect task/definitions; recruit and roster; report proposed/approved policy state and gaps; no fabricated approval/hire.

scenarios.request: Launch the already approved reviewer for TM-123, using its definition.
scenarios.expected: Inspect readiness and roster; narrow hire KEY --name NAME; preserve disabled-policy/capacity errors; no model/actor overrides.
scenarios.nearMiss: Change reviewer configuration to skip approval.

scenarios.request: Collect the finished members for TM-123 into its lead integration worktree.
scenarios.expected: Inspect evidence/status; authorized dispatch collect; preserve conflict/live/dirty/branch refusal; no card close/release merge.
scenarios.nearMiss: Merge this platform feature branch into main.

scenarios.request: Show the current dispatch limit and change it to 2 as requested.
scenarios.expected: Read config first; typed config setting mutation via runtime; report result; no unrelated approval/auth changes.
scenarios.nearMiss: Print the provider API token so I can check it.

scenarios.request: Why is TM-123 not ready? Diagnose without launching or changing anything.
scenarios.expected: doctor --strict, definitions and dispatch status; concrete failure/remedy; no automatic policy/auth repair.
scenarios.nearMiss: Fix an unrelated Python application bug.
